tracks.title: Library habit survey

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: こんにちは。図書館のアンケートです。よく本を読みますか。
turns.english: Hello. This is a library survey. Do you often read books?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: はい、いつも夜に本を読みます。
turns.english: Yes, I always read books at night.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 日本語も勉強しますか。

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: はい、ときどき図書館で勉強します。でも、朝はあまり勉強しません。
turns.english: Yes, I sometimes study at the library. But I don't study much in the morning.

comprehensionPrompts: How often does he study at the library?

tracks.title: Exercise habit survey

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 運動について聞きます。よく歩きますか。
turns.english: I'll ask about exercise. Do you walk often?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: はい、よく公園を歩きます。
turns.english: Yes, I often walk in the park.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: いいえ、ぜんぜん走りません。でも、ときどき家でヨガをします。
turns.english: No, I never run. But I sometimes do yoga at home.

comprehensionPrompts: What does she sometimes do at home?
